reviews.title: Crazy good for the price, huge upgrade from my old setup
reviews.comment: A couple years ago, around 2019, I bought an HP Omen monitor. It was 240Hz, 1080p, about 24 inches, and at the time that was a huge deal. I remember paying like $500 for it. It was great back then. I just upgraded to this monitor and I was honestly shocked at the price. I think it was around $200, which is insane for what you’re getting now compared to a few years ago. Colors look great, super smooth, and the extra size and curve make gaming way more immersive. It’s lightweight too, so if you’re using a VESA mount it doesn’t sag or droop at all. Mounted easy, no issues. For the price, I’m honestly really impressed. Huge screen, 240Hz, clean picture, and affordable. Definitely happy with it.
reviews.author: Forrest
